breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The simulation is for Rayleigh-Bénard convection, which is driven by a vertical temperature gradient (heated from below along the Z-axis). For buoyancy to cause convection, gravity must act in the same vertical direction. The generated specification incorrectly sets the gravity vector to `g (-9.81 0 0)`, which is horizontal. The correct vector for this setup would be `g (0 0 -9.81)`.
